fullPassage: The expression "Moveable Feast" originally referred to the changing date of religious celebrations. It was later adopted by Ernest Hemingway to describe his experience of living in Paris. We use the term Moveable Feast to conceptualize the potentiality to connect with people, ideas, and information at any time and in any place. In the Digital Age, information circulates and travels not only in a straight line from official media outlets to consumers but has the potential to move from anyone to everyone else. The Moveable Feast is a table filled with information "dishes" that have been prepared by participating members of the feast. Each person may try a slice of everyone else's dish. Furthermore, this feast moves around the entire world and interacts with billions of other feasts-of-digits, complete with servings of information that are monitored by platforms and governments. At any given point in time, each person has the potential to connect with any other person by sampling their information, and perhaps by "dishing dirt" of their own, or by rejecting dishes that are not particularly tasty. This feast features all the components of social interaction in complex, dynamic information environments; as Hemingway most aptly described, "it stays with you" wherever you go.

We use the term Moveable Feast to conceptualize the potentiality to connect with people, ideas, and information at any time and in any place. In the Digital Age, information circulates and travels not only in a straight line from official media outlets to consumers but has the potential to move from anyone to everyone else. The Moveable Feast is a table filled with information "dishes" that have been prepared by participating members of the feast. Each person may try a slice of everyone else's dish. Furthermore, this feast moves around the entire world and interacts with billions of other feasts-of-digits, complete with servings of information that are monitored by platforms and governments. At any given point in time, each person has the potential to connect with any other person by sampling their information, and perhaps by "dishing dirt" of their own, or by rejecting dishes that are not particularly tasty. This feast features all the components of social interaction in complex, dynamic information environments; as Hemingway most aptly described, "it stays with you" wherever you go.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

det.korean: 정부는 정보를 '감시(monitored)'할 뿐 만들어 내는 주체로 언급되지 않는다. 따라서 ④가 불일치.
det.analysis:
✅ ① the changing date of religious celebrations — 일치
✅ ② adopted by Ernest Hemingway to describe his experience ... in Paris — 일치
✅ ③ has the potential to move from anyone to everyone else — 일치
❌ ④ 정부는 monitored(감시)의 주체일 뿐 정보 생산자 아님 ←정답(불일치)
det.tip: monitored by platforms and governments = 감시일 뿐 생산 아님

이 축제 위의 정보는 오직 정부만이 만들어 낸다.
